text.description_html:
Pop Up Pocket Door Edge Pull, Emtek LC6TUBPKTLATCHPASUS3

This door pull installs in the edge of the door to pull a sliding door out of its pocket. The Solid Brass Pocket Door Pull is a spring loaded pull that pops out when pushed and stays retracted when pushed back into the door. Its narrow width allows for installation on narrow or standard 1-3/8 inch wide doors.

Specifications for the Pop Up Pocket Door Edge Pull, Emtek LC6TUBPKTLATCHPASUS3:

  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Finish: Polished Brass

Sold Individually
